storyTemplate.title: The Last Light at Bramble Bridge
storyTemplate.description: The festival starts at dusk, but Bramble Bridge has lost its lantern. Help a stubborn bridgekeeper find a way to light the crossing.

title_card_image.title: Bramble Bridge at dusk
title_card_image.prompt: A small stone footbridge over a shallow stream, village festival bunting and an empty iron lantern hook, soft amber dusk, illustrated fantasy landscape, no lettering.

meta.story_guidance: Tell a short, cozy fantasy adventure. Respect the player’s chosen method. Mira offers practical help without solving tasks for the player. Keep responses concise and leave room for dialogue. The missing lantern is an ordinary accident, not a hidden villain or supernatural crisis.

player.name: Rowan Reed
player.personality_description: Patient and curious, Rowan remembers promises and notices practical details. He can mend a strap but is no expert craftsperson. He worries about disappointing neighbors and sometimes takes on too many errands.
player.speech_style: Warm, plain-spoken sentences with occasional understated humor.
player.starting_state_of_mind: Concerned about the missing bridge lantern, but ready to help.

appearance.body_description: A lean, wiry build accustomed to walking long distances.
appearance.extra_description: A small pale scar at the left temple.

starting_known_facts: Rowan carries messages between Bramble village and nearby farms.
Rowan grew up in Bramble and knows bridgekeeper Mira Bellweather.
Rowan promised to deliver the festival invitations before dusk.

Mira Bellweather.name: Mira Bellweather
Mira Bellweather.note: Bridgekeeper and lantern maker; knows Rowan from village deliveries.
Mira Bellweather.current_appearance: Standing beside the empty lantern hook with a canvas tool roll.

full_character.name: Mira Bellweather
full_character.personality_description: Methodical, kind, and quietly stubborn. Mira takes pride in maintaining public things that others overlook. She taps a thumb against her tool roll when thinking. Her patience frays when people treat every old object as disposable; she admits when she needs help.
full_character.speech_style: Brief, concrete explanations, dry humor, and a reassuring tone when someone struggles.
full_character.starting_state_of_mind: Concerned about the missing bridge lantern, but ready to help.

appearance.body_description: A stocky, sturdy build with a relaxed, practical bearing.
appearance.extra_description: A scattering of freckles across her nose.

starting_known_facts: Mira has maintained Bramble Bridge for sixteen years.
Mira made the bridge lantern with her father and repairs it each spring.
Mira keeps a spare lantern frame and amber glass in her workshop.

scene.summary: At dusk, Mira Bellweather waits beside the empty lantern hook on Bramble Bridge. Festival ribbons stir above the shallow stream.
scene.image_action: Mira studies an empty iron lantern hook while holding a folded tool roll.

story_rules.text: No one is in immediate danger. The stream is shallow; any recovery can be done safely from the bank with the available rake.
The festival waits for the bridge light; there is no hidden countdown or forced failure.

bramble-bridge.name: Bramble Bridge
bramble-bridge.summary: A stone footbridge with festival ribbons and an empty lantern hook.

willow-bank.name: Willow Bank
willow-bank.summary: A shallow, muddy bank below the bridge; a long-handled rake rests by the steps.

lantern-workshop.name: Mira’s Workshop
lantern-workshop.summary: A tidy workshop beside the bridge, stocked with spare lantern parts.

items.title: Examine the empty hook
items.summary: Mira is beside the bridge’s empty hook. Ask what happened or examine the fastening to work out the available options.
items.while_active_guidance: Let the player act at their own pace. Do not complete the next task in the same response.
items.completion_criteria: The player learns that the lantern may be below the bridge and that spare parts are available in the workshop.

next_objectives.completion_instruction: Mira explains that a bent fastening suggests a fall into the shallows. She points out the bank rake and the workshop spare parts. Present both options, then stop before choosing for the player.

items.title: Choose a way to light the bridge
items.summary: Search the shallow bank for the old lantern, or help Mira build a replacement in her workshop.
items.while_active_guidance: Both paths are practical and safe. The player may ask questions before choosing.

choices.title: Recover the old lantern
choices.summary: Look among the willow roots below the bridge.
choices.player_text: Let’s look for the old lantern by the willow roots.
choices.completion_instruction: Mira sets the bank rake by the steps and offers to steady it. Establish the search without retrieving the lantern yet.

choices.title: Build a replacement
choices.summary: Use the spare frame and amber glass in the workshop.
choices.player_text: Let’s put together a replacement in your workshop.
choices.completion_instruction: Mira opens her workshop and lays out the spare frame, glass, and fasteners. Leave the assembly to the player.

items.title: Lift the lantern from the roots
items.summary: The shallow willow bank has a long-handled rake. Look for the fallen lantern and bring it safely within reach.
items.while_active_guidance: Let the player act at their own pace. Do not complete the next task in the same response.
items.completion_criteria: The old lantern has been safely recovered from the willow roots.

next_objectives.completion_instruction: The intact lantern is recovered. Mira checks its hinge and offers a fresh candle, then waits for the player to light and hang it.

items.title: Assemble the spare lantern
items.summary: Mira has set a spare frame, amber glass, and simple fasteners on her workbench. She can explain how they fit.
items.while_active_guidance: Let the player act at their own pace. Do not complete the next task in the same response.
items.completion_criteria: A usable replacement lantern has been assembled.

next_objectives.completion_instruction: The replacement is ready. Mira checks the fasteners and supplies a candle. Return attention to the bridge hook without lighting or hanging the lantern for the player.

items.title: Light the crossing
items.summary: A working lantern is ready. Mira has a candle and taper; the repaired hook waits on the bridge.
items.while_active_guidance: Let the player act at their own pace. Do not complete the next task in the same response.
items.completion_criteria: The player lights and hangs the usable lantern on Bramble Bridge.

next_objectives.completion_instruction: Describe the amber light reaching the bridge stones and the first festival visitors crossing. Mira thanks the player in her reserved, sincere way. Leave the evening open for conversation or exploring the festival.
next_objectives.ending_message: The crossing glows again. Music carries across the water, and the festival evening is yours to enjoy.

world_notes: Bramble celebrates its spring festival this evening.
Mira’s workshop stands next to Bramble Bridge.
unresolved_threads: The bridge lantern is missing from its hook.
relationship_notes: Mira knows the default courier Rowan through village deliveries. Other player characters begin as visitors.
ai_private_notes: A gust dislodged the old lantern. It rests intact in willow roots below the bridge; discovery requires looking there. A spare can instead be assembled from the workshop parts. Neither method is morally superior.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
Festival ribbons flutter above Bramble Bridge, their colors fading into the blue of early evening. From the village square comes the tentative squeak of a fiddle being tuned.

Beside the bridge, Mira Bellweather studies an empty iron hook. Her rust-red sleeves are rolled neatly to her wrists; a folded canvas tool roll rests in one hand.

“The one evening everyone needs the light,” she says, “and the lantern decides to take a holiday.” She glances toward the shallow stream, then at the workshop door. “I could use another pair of eyes.”
